name: pmc-degoog-extensions
description: Small collection of vibecoded plugins by pmc
author: Pimonychan

plugins.name: Animated background(s)
plugins.description: Adds a video background/live wallpaper to the home page, using a direct MP4 video remote URL or locally stored MP4/WEBM video(s).

plugins.name: Plugins Update Notifier
plugins.description: Adds a notification icon to the main and results pages to indicate when one or more updates are available for your installed plugins from the repositories.
